versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Find speaking and podcast guest opportunities on Twitter using apidojo’s Twitter scrapers
- Returns structured results including event name, organizer handle, topic focus, deadline signals, event size, and submission URL
- Fully customizable search with advanced Twitter query support and filtering options (e.g. date, language, verification)
- Prioritizes, classifies, and scores results for keynote, panel, podcast, summit, and workshop opportunities
- Output includes handling for edge cases, minimum criteria, and troubleshooting tips
